title: Every Fight Is Followed By A Century

runtime.timing: requestAnimationFrame with variable delta capped at 50ms; window.advanceTime exposes fixed 60Hz stepping for observation
runtime.input: Logical action state in src/input.ts with held, pressed, released, pointer-lock look, and deterministic frame consumption
runtime.camera: Third-person chase camera with yaw/pitch clamp, speed FOV, pointer lock, obstruction pull-in, shake reduction, and sensitivity settings
runtime.physics: application-owned kinematic traversal plus bounded rubble velocities; no general-purpose rigid-body solver
runtime.combat: bounded player strike/shockwave, pursuing rival, and player vitality; no environmental enemy destruction
runtime.destruction: stateful building/bridge integrity and support propagation, visible rubble, and terrain scars; no general-purpose structural solver
runtime.persistence: version-2 localStorage campaign envelope with versionless-save rewrite and malformed/future-save recovery; no IndexedDB
runtime.tests: 16 Vitest checks, direct Playwright traversal/destruction/combat journey, and a request-animation-frame Phase 1 performance baseline

truthBoundary: The active entry completes the bounded Phase 1 traversal gate but is not the canonical 100,000-year campaign world. Its compact history and deep-time helpers, and all later phase systems, remain provisional until their completion contracts are proven.
